name: Vaporwave desktop
doc: Win95-style windows drawn in code (bevelled frames, gradient title bars, min/max/close buttons, hard drop shadows) that zoom open on the beat grid, hold for a few beats and close, each showing big pseudo-kanji glyphs, a chunky progress bar filling to the beat, or an error dialog. A column of procedurally drawn kanji-like glyphs changes every bar. Bass bumps the windows, onsets flash the glyphs. Transparent background (premultiplied: blend with 'over').

tint.doc: palette position of the title bars (gradient to tint + 0.25)

kanji.doc: brightness of the glyph column (0 = off)
